name: Robert Kyle
caption: Jersey Jack Grappling's head booker, repackaged from a prior gimmick into a logo-covered showman surrounded by twenty bodyguards.

tenures.source: Introduced in the promotion's own handbook as its head booker, formerly billed under an earlier gimmick; delivered an in-ring promo at the first house show previewing the tag titles and the top championship.

name: Jack Britain
caption: Jersey Jack Grappling's face announcer and backstage trainer, billed as a thirty-year wrestling veteran.

tenures.source: Introduced in the promotion's own handbook as its face announcer and in-house trainer; called the action at the first house show.

name: Jenna McDougal
caption: Jersey Jack Grappling's heel announcer, credited with a prior stint as a referee for the predecessor promotion.

tenures.source: Introduced in the promotion's own handbook as its heel announcer.

name: Richard Jameson
caption: Jersey Jack Grappling's backstage interviewer and the host of its secondary broadcast.

tenures.source: Introduced in the promotion's own handbook as the host of its secondary program and its backstage interviewer.

name: Tariq Abdul Aziz
caption: One of Jersey Jack Grappling's four referees, described in its own handbook as its most confrontational official.

tenures.source: Introduced in the promotion's own handbook as a referee; oversaw a tag match at the first house show.

name: Freddie Jacobs
caption: One of Jersey Jack Grappling's four referees, a former independent hand built up into a physically imposing official.

tenures.source: Introduced in the promotion's own handbook as a referee; oversaw the opening match of the first house show.

name: Minnie McDougal
caption: Jersey Jack Grappling's only female referee, introduced in its own handbook as the younger sister of its heel announcer.

tenures.source: Introduced in the promotion's own handbook as its only female referee.

name: James Randal Brannon
caption: One of Jersey Jack Grappling's four referees, a thirty-year in-ring veteran billed as its senior official.

tenures.source: Introduced in the promotion's own handbook as its senior referee; oversaw the main event of the first house show.

name: Bobby Black
caption: Jersey Jack Grappling's voice-over announcer, a veteran of low-budget film narration.

tenures.source: Introduced in the promotion's own handbook as its voice-over announcer.

name: "Emo(tional)" Eric Echo
caption: A Jersey Jack Grappling wrestler from Trenton who won his first house-show match by finishing his opponent with an inverted implant DDT.

tenures.source: Won the opening match of the first house show after his opponent's foreign-object attack went unpunished, finishing with an inverted implant DDT.

name: "The Rush" E.J. Drivven
caption: A Jersey Jack Grappling wrestler who won his first house-show match with a series of suplexes and a hooked backdrop driver.

tenures.source: Won his first house-show match with a gutwrench sitdown powerbomb, a run of suplexes, and a hooked backdrop driver.

name: Drunkaholic
caption: Half of the Jersey Jack Grappling tag team Corrupted Morals, billed as a drunk.

tenures.source: Won a tag match against the Pain Brothers on the promotion's first house show with a top-rope inverted DDT.

identity.note: Shares the bare ring name "Drunkaholic" with an unrelated recurring house-show wrestler in another wing's own roster; this one debuted for a different, later promotion with a different tag partner and no roster overlap.

name: Lint
caption: Half of the Jersey Jack Grappling tag team Corrupted Morals.

tenures.source: Won a tag match against the Pain Brothers on the promotion's first house show, landing an unseen chair shot.

name: "Super Stud" Bret Lane
caption: A small, quick Jersey Jack Grappling wrestler who won his first house-show match against a much larger opponent.

tenures.source: Won his first house-show match against a much larger opponent with a low blow and a rollup.

name: "Kaotic Nightmare" Sid Savage
caption: A Jersey Jack Grappling wrestler billed as a mailman, who won his first house-show match with a bridging brainbuster.

tenures.source: Won his first house-show match against a smaller opponent with a bridging brainbuster.

name: Cameron Hawkins
caption: A Jersey Jack Grappling wrestler who won the main event of the promotion's first house show with a skytwister press.

tenures.source: Won the main event of the promotion's first house show with a top-rope skytwister press after absorbing a long beating.

name: Julian Campbell
caption: A newly signed Jersey Jack Grappling wrestler introduced at the promotion's first house show with a crossdressing gimmick.

tenures.source: Introduced to the crowd as a newly signed wrestler at the promotion's first house show; no match write-up survives.

name: The Great Dave
caption: A newly signed Jersey Jack Grappling wrestler introduced at the promotion's first house show, billed from Japan.

tenures.source: Introduced to the crowd as a newly signed wrestler at the promotion's first house show; no match write-up survives.
